ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool Service Registration or Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects installation or execution of services Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND (event_id = 7045 OR event_id = 7036)) AND ((ServiceName = RGX(".*cachedump.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*DumpSvc.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*gsecdump.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*pwdump.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*UACBypassedService.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*WCE\\ SERVICE.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*WCESERVICE.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*winexesvc.*")) OR ImagePath = RGX(".*bypass.*"))
